document.abstract: In a new system of varioscopic cinematography, the image ratio of the screen changes in the process of film presentation according to its contents. The image emphasizes rectangular and horizontal, vertical and square dimensions. In the process of further experimental work on 70mm film, important techniques, parameters and facilities for variofilm shooting, printing and projection were established. Creative-artistic, psychophysiological and technical-economical aspects of these problems were considered. Preconditions were created for practical application of the new system of varioscopic cinematography in professional motion pictures.
